## 6. Claims explicitly excluded from verification

- Thirteen of the residues in MurJ that Sgls contact are completely conserved across diderms.
  - Reason:Requires a multiple sequence alignment over diderm MurJ orthologues, which is not part of this repository. Note that 13 is a SEQUENCE-conservation count; it is not the same quantity as the geometric convergence count computed here (residues contacting the peptide in all three deposited structures).
  - Original text:"Thirteen of the residues in MurJ that Sgls contact are completely conserved across diderms"(Fig. 4f)
- Sgls stall the lipid II transport cycle by trapping MurJ in an outward-facing (periplasm-open) state.
  - Reason:A conformational claim. This repository measures the peptide-bound state only; state selectivity must be tested downstream against an inward-facing structure.

## 8. Reproduction commands

```bash
python run_evidence.py --out evidence      # This report + All tables
python run_pipeline.py --out results       # Design output (using the same priors)
python tests/test_smoke.py                 # Self-check
```

 Modify `priors/murj_priors.json` to replace literature priors or mutation data without code changes; results appear in section 5 .
